title: Replication package: Does Cross-Exchange Fragmentation Distort Cryptocurrency Risk Measures? Evidence from Venue Comparison and Stablecoin Micro-Depeg Prediction
description: Replication code and processed datasets for the study of cross-venue fragmentation in centralized cryptocurrency markets and next-day stablecoin micro-depeg prediction. Includes the balanced three-venue daily panel for BTC and ETH (Binance, Kraken, Coinbase, Feb 2024 - Feb 2026), the matched USDT/USD and USDC/USD panels, all analysis scripts, and the Heliyon major-revision (2026) analyses (stress-conditional fragmentation, Newey-West spread significance, rolling-window and bootstrap block-length robustness, extended threshold sweep, and the corrected variance-share table).
